title: Can AI match emergency physicians in managing common emergency cases? A comparative performance evaluation
summary: The paper compared AI-generated emergency-case management with physician responses in structured scenarios and measured concordance; it reports poorer reliability in complex cases and does not support replacement of clinical judgment. The publisher lists 2025/12; the first version reporting this result is dated 2025-07-31.
